```{r, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

`lcNRB` stores each distinct workbook under its SHA-256 hash. A dry run compares
the live content without modifying the cache.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(lcNRB)
lc_update(dry_run = TRUE)
report <- lc_update()
lc_cache_info()
```

The repository workflow runs this process weekly, validates changed files, and
opens (but never merges) a pull request only when tracked data artifacts change.
The workflow needs `contents: write` and `pull-requests: write` permissions.
